description: Uniformly replacing auxiliary parameters by terms in a finite proof gives a finite proof of the correspondingly substituted conclusion from the correspondingly substituted assumptions.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Proof.substitute.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α β : Type w}
  {Γ : Finset (L.Formula α)} {A : L.Formula α} (σ : α → L.Term β)
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Proof L Γ A) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Proof L
    (Finset.image (fun φ => FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.subst φ σ) Γ)
    (FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.subst A σ)
